title: Google Image metadata
statusNote: Active; powers the Licensable badge and C2PA 'About this image' details. Page last updated earlier than the rest (2025-12-10).
notes: url is accepted in place of contentUrl but is less precise.
contentUrl required (url is accepted as fallback but less precise).

One of creator/creditText/copyrightNotice/license is required; once one is present the other three become recommended in the Rich Results Test. license is needed for the Licensable badge; acquireLicensePage recommended with it. creator is Organization or Person.
Equivalent IPTC embedded fields: Copyright Notice, Creator, Credit Line, Digital Source Type, Licensor URL, Web Statement of Rights (needed for Licensable badge).
Digital Source Type values: trainedAlgorithmicMedia, compositeSynthetic, algorithmicMedia, compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia.
